learn.rule: Grow a short sentence by adding who, what, when, where, and why. A bigger sentence tells the reader more.
learn.ruleEs: Haz crecer una oración corta agregando quién, qué, cuándo, dónde y por qué. Una oración más grande le dice más al lector.
learn.model: Bees buzz. Early in the morning, bees buzz around the garden flowers.
learn.notice: Which words tell when? Which words tell where?

items.prompt: Which question does 'in the garden' answer?
items.text: Bees collect nectar in the garden.
items.why: In the garden tells the place, so it answers where.
items.whyEs: In the garden dice el lugar, así que responde dónde.

items.text: Bees leave the hive every morning.
items.why: Every morning tells the time, so it answers when.
items.whyEs: Every morning dice el momento, así que responde cuándo.

items.prompt: Which question does 'to make honey' answer?
items.text: Bees gather nectar to make honey.
items.why: To make honey tells the purpose, so it answers why.
items.whyEs: To make honey dice el propósito, así que responde por qué.

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells where.
items.model: The ants carry crumbs to their nest every afternoon.
items.why: To their nest is a place. At noon and last week tell time, and every afternoon already does that.
items.whyEs: To their nest es un lugar. At noon y last week dicen el tiempo, y every afternoon ya lo dice.

items.prompt: Check every expansion of 'The butterfly rests' that tells where.

options.text: The butterfly rests on a purple flower.
The butterfly rests after a long flight.
The butterfly rests under a green leaf.
The butterfly rests because it is tired.

items.why: On a purple flower and under a green leaf name places. After a long flight tells when, and because it is tired tells why.
items.whyEs: On a purple flower y under a green leaf nombran lugares. After a long flight dice cuándo, y because it is tired dice por qué.

items.prompt: Which is the strongest expansion of the kernel 'A spider spins'?

options.text: Early in the morning, a spider spins a silky web in the garden.

items.why: This one adds when (early in the morning), what (a silky web) and where (in the garden).
items.whyEs: Esta agrega cuándo (early in the morning), qué (a silky web) y dónde (in the garden).

write.prompt: Expand the kernel sentence. Tell when and where.
write.promptEs: Expande la oración base. Di cuándo y dónde.
write.model: At sunrise, the bird sang a sweet song from the top of the tree.

familyTalk.en: Pick a short sentence like 'The dog ran.' Take turns adding when, where, or why until it is a big sentence.
familyTalk.es: Elijan una oración corta como 'The dog ran.' Túrnense para agregar cuándo, dónde o por qué hasta tener una oración grande.

teacherTip.en: Write the question words on cards and have partners pick one card at a time to grow the kernel.
teacherTip.es: Escribe las palabras interrogativas en tarjetas y pide que las parejas elijan una a la vez para hacer crecer la oración base.

learn.rule: Grow a short sentence by adding who, what, when, where, and why. Each detail answers one question.
learn.ruleEs: Haz crecer una oración corta agregando quién, qué, cuándo, dónde y por qué. Cada detalle responde una pregunta.
learn.model: People shop. On Saturday, families shop at the farmers market for fresh food.
learn.notice: On Saturday tells when. At the farmers market tells where. For fresh food tells why.

items.text: Families visit the market on Saturday.
items.why: On Saturday names a day, so it answers when.
items.whyEs: On Saturday nombra un día, así que responde cuándo.

items.prompt: Which question does 'at the market' answer?
items.text: Jamal sells apples at the market.
items.why: At the market names a place, so it answers where.
items.whyEs: At the market nombra un lugar, así que responde dónde.

items.prompt: Which question does 'to feed the town' answer?
items.text: Farmers grow vegetables to feed the town.
items.why: To feed the town gives the purpose, so it answers why.
items.whyEs: To feed the town da el propósito, así que responde por qué.

items.prompt: Check every expansion of 'The bakery opens' that tells when.

options.text: The bakery opens at six o'clock.
The bakery opens on Main Street.
The bakery opens before the school bell rings.
The bakery opens for hungry neighbors.

items.why: At six o'clock and before the school bell rings are times. On Main Street is a place, and for hungry neighbors is a reason.
items.whyEs: At six o'clock y before the school bell rings son momentos. On Main Street es un lugar, y for hungry neighbors es una razón.

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells why.
items.model: The baker wakes up early to bake fresh bread.
items.why: To bake fresh bread gives a reason. On Monday tells when and near the oven tells where.
items.whyEs: To bake fresh bread da una razón. On Monday dice cuándo y near the oven dice dónde.

items.prompt: Which is the strongest expansion of the kernel 'The farmer sells'?

options.text: On Saturday mornings, the farmer sells sweet corn at the town market.

items.why: It tells when (on Saturday mornings), what (sweet corn) and where (at the town market).
items.whyEs: Dice cuándo (on Saturday mornings), qué (sweet corn) y dónde (at the town market).

write.prompt: Expand the kernel sentence. Tell when and where.
write.promptEs: Expande la oración base. Di cuándo y dónde.
write.model: On Saturday morning, the children shop with their parents at the busy town market.

familyTalk.en: Think of a place you visit each week. Say one short sentence, then add when, where, and why.
familyTalk.es: Piensen en un lugar que visitan cada semana. Digan una oración corta y luego agreguen cuándo, dónde y por qué.

teacherTip.en: Color-code details: blue for when, green for where, orange for why. Use the colors as students expand.
teacherTip.es: Usa colores para los detalles: azul para cuándo, verde para dónde, naranja para por qué. Úsalos mientras expanden.

learn.rule: Grow a short sentence by adding who, what, when, where, and why. Details help the reader picture it.
learn.ruleEs: Haz crecer una oración corta agregando quién, qué, cuándo, dónde y por qué. Los detalles ayudan al lector a imaginarlo.
learn.model: Mia paints. After lunch, Mia paints a bright mural on the school wall.
learn.notice: After lunch tells when. On the school wall tells where.

items.why: After lunch tells the time, so it answers when.
items.whyEs: After lunch dice el momento, así que responde cuándo.

items.prompt: Which question does 'on the school wall' answer?
items.text: Mia paints a mural on the school wall.
items.why: On the school wall names a place, so it answers where.
items.whyEs: On the school wall nombra un lugar, así que responde dónde.

items.prompt: Which question does 'to show her favorite animals' answer?
items.text: Mia paints pictures to show her favorite animals.
items.why: To show her favorite animals gives the purpose, so it answers why.
items.whyEs: To show her favorite animals da el propósito, así que responde por qué.

items.prompt: Check every expansion of 'The students sing' that tells where.

options.text: The students sing in the music room.
The students sing on the stage.
The students sing to warm up their voices.

items.why: In the music room and on the stage are places. Every Friday tells when, and to warm up their voices tells why.
items.whyEs: In the music room y on the stage son lugares. Every Friday dice cuándo, y to warm up their voices dice por qué.

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells when.
items.model: Leo plays the drum after school.
items.why: After school is a time. In the band room is a place, and to keep the beat is a reason.
items.whyEs: After school es un momento. In the band room es un lugar, y to keep the beat es una razón.

items.prompt: Which is the strongest expansion of the kernel 'The dancers move'?

options.text: At the festival, the dancers move to the drumbeat in bright costumes.

items.why: It tells where (at the festival), how (to the drumbeat) and what they wear (bright costumes).
items.whyEs: Dice dónde (at the festival), cómo (to the drumbeat) y qué llevan puesto (bright costumes).

write.prompt: Expand the kernel sentence. Tell when and where.
write.promptEs: Expande la oración base. Di cuándo y dónde.
write.model: On Friday night, the band played happy songs on the stage at school.

familyTalk.en: Pick a song or a drawing you like. Say one short sentence about it, then add when and where.
familyTalk.es: Elijan una canción o un dibujo que les guste. Digan una oración corta sobre eso y agreguen cuándo y dónde.

teacherTip.en: After typing, have partners circle the when and where details in each other's sentences.
teacherTip.es: Después de escribir, pide que las parejas encierren en un círculo los detalles de cuándo y dónde en las oraciones del otro.
